mechanics.description_raw: Increases ATK by 12%. When the wielder inflicts Fusion Burst Effect or Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, it increases their Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus by 36% for 5s. Under this effect, when Resonators in the team inflict Fusion Burst Effect or Tune Strain - Shifting, their ATK is increased by 24% for 15s. Effects of the same name cannot be stacked.
